candidate_windows.window_text: The WikiSection SP Encoder was trained on 1 A100 GPU for about 1O hours using the training set of WikiSection for 1OO epochs.We used SGD optimizer and set the learning rate to be le-9. The $\epsilon$ in the loss function $L _ { \mathrm { { N L L } } }$ is chosen as $1 e { \mathrm { - } } 7 .$ The WikiText SP Encoder was trained on 4 A100 GPUs for roughly 20 hours for 4 epochs with WikiText dataset.For this dataset, we trained with AdamW optimizer with learning rate $\mathit { l e } { \cdot } 9$ and batch size 32.The $\epsilon$ in the loss function $L _ { \mathrm { { N L L } } }$ is chosen as le-3. Other hyperparameters can be accessed from the configuration file in the submitted code. Our empirical results show incorporating $\hat { \sigma } _ { j }$ into the $\widehat { \Sigma } _ { j }$ makes no significant results in the downstream tasks, thus we disregard $\hat { \sigma } _ { j }$ during encoder training.
